newsitem.title: USA: CME scraps rolling spot,currency forward contracts.
newsitem.headline: CME scraps rolling spot,currency forward contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Mercantile Exchange said Friday its board declared dormant the exchange's rolling spot and currency forward contracts, effective immediately.

The CME, in notices distributed Friday on the trading floor, said the board at its January 8 meeting decided to no longer offer for trading rolling spot futures and futures-options in pounds and marks and rolling spot futures in yen, as well as currency forwards in marks and yen.

Additionally, CME will not list any new contract months in the products, none of which had any open interest at the time the board acted, the notices said. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com))
